style: STYLE: 2D hand-painted digital illustration, painterly semi-realism with visible soft brushwork, like a premium illustrated merge game. NOT 3D, not a photo, not anime, not flat vector. rules: RULES: Square picture (1:1). ONE single object, centred, filling about 80 percent of the frame, on a plain soft light-gray background exactly like the attached item pictures.
